当你需要快速集成常用业务场景的UI组件时，应使用Scenario Fusion Kit的场景化Button和Input组件
例如需要一键验证用户手机号、选择用户头像、选择收货地址、地图选点等高频场景，只需一行代码即可启用，大幅提升开发效率
当你需要为应用提供智能表单填充能力时，应使用Scenario Fusion Kit的智能填充服务
它可以根据用户历史数据智能推荐输入建议，实现复杂表单一键填充，支持多种前端框架和H5页面接入
当你需要获取系统信息属性或系统设置属性时，该Kit提供的场景化API可以简化开发流程
接入一键获取本机手机号的快速验证按钮 / Integrate a one-tap button to verify and fetch the device phone number
添加选择收货地址组件并自动回填姓名电话和地址 / Add an address picker and auto-fill recipient name, phone, and shipping address
实现地图选点后回填经纬度和详细地址 / Implement map location picking and write back latitude, longitude, and the full address
用省市区选择器快速填写地区字段 / Use a province-city-district picker to quickly fill regional fields
在注册或下单表单中接入智能填充减少手动输入 / Integrate smart autofill into registration or checkout forms to reduce manual typing
自动补全联系人信息和地址信息到表单 / Auto-fill contact details and address information into a form
在 Web 页面里调用智能表单组件完成地址和手机号填写 / Invoke smart form components in a web page to fill address and phone fields
在 Flutter 或 React Native 页面嵌入 HarmonyOS 智能填充能力 / Embed HarmonyOS smart autofill capabilities in Flutter or React Native pages
获取设备系统信息和系统设置用于场景化表单展示 / Get device system info and settings for scenario-based form presentation
实现推荐车牌号并一键填入车辆信息表单 / Implement suggested license plate numbers and fill them into a vehicle information form with one tap
集成系统级智能输入控件提升下单填写效率 / Integrate system-level smart input controls to speed up checkout form entry
管理按钮点击后拉起系统融合场景页面的交互流程 / Manage the interaction flow that launches a system fusion scenario page after a button tap
do_not_use_when: 需求是进行Canvas/自定义绘制、几何图形与文本渲染、图片处理或可变帧率显示效果，应改用 arkgraphics-2d / The task is about canvas-style custom drawing, geometry and text rendering, image processing, or variable refresh rate visual effects; use arkgraphics-2d instead

需求是适配TalkBack朗读、无障碍焦点、语义标注或无障碍事件通知，应改用 accessibility-kit / The task is to support TalkBack reading, accessibility focus, semantic annotations, or accessibility event notifications; use accessibility-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已接入Scenario Fusion Kit对应SDK能力，并在当前HarmonyOS版本与设备形态上受支持 / The project has integrated the Scenario Fusion Kit SDK capability and the current HarmonyOS version and device form are supported

若使用按钮拉起系统页面、账号相关能力或系统属性访问，所需权限、配置项与拉起条件已在module.json5等工程配置中正确声明 / If using buttons that launch system pages, account-related capabilities, or system property access, the required permissions, config entries, and launch conditions have been correctly declared in module.json5 and related project files
若使用智能填充，应用或H5页面已按接入文档完成ContentType及相关映射配置 / If using smart autofill, the app or H5 page has completed ContentType and related mapping configuration according to the integration docs

postconditions.statement: 已在ArkUI界面中接入目标场景化Button、Input或相关API调用，并与对应业务事件绑定 / The target scenario Button, Input, or related API call has been integrated into the ArkUI UI and bound to the corresponding business event
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify ArkUI/component code or invocation code that integrates a Scenario Fusion button, input, or API and connects it to a user flow?

postconditions.statement: 若使用智能填充，表单字段已配置合适的ContentType或框架映射关系，以支持推荐与自动填充 / If smart autofill is used, form fields have appropriate ContentType or framework mapping configured to support recommendations and autofill
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task involves smart autofill, do the edits show ContentType annotations or equivalent framework-to-HarmonyOS mapping configuration for the relevant form fields?

postconditions.statement: 实现中体现了该场景组件或API的必要前置校验、失败处理或降级路径 / The implementation includes necessary prechecks, failure handling, or fallback paths for the chosen scenario component or API
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include checks, error handling, or fallback logic for cases where the Scenario Fusion capability cannot be launched, is unsupported, or returns failure?
